decisions.reason: The source Event identifies the YouTube replacement as an iOS media change; it does not necessarily alter the Android tutorial-asset strategy.
The existing message-193 MODIFY already removes the obsolete localized_tutorial_asset_strategy key, and no additional size-optimization state change is entailed.
Replacing iOS tutorial images with a YouTube video does not change Android full-app localization or its required language coverage.
The media replacement does not necessarily change the requirement to localize the full iOS app or its App Store language coverage.
Changing tutorial delivery from images to a YouTube video does not modify the iOS framework, deprecated-API, or maintainability requirements.
The tutorial-media replacement does not alter the requirement for an iOS Privacy Manifest.
The source decision has no effect on Android permission policy or the removal of READ_PHONE_STATE.
The tutorial-media replacement does not affect iOS signing certificates or submission signing configuration.
Replacing tutorial images with video does not remove or modify the requirement for correct right-to-left layout behavior.
The source decision concerns How-To media delivery and does not entail any change to iPad layout cleanup.
Tutorial-image replacement does not necessarily change the independently requested cleanup of application skin graphics.
The iOS tutorial-media change does not modify Android platform compatibility, deprecated-API refactoring, or maintainability requirements.
